input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no express "liquidated damages" or "penalty" clause payable by Customer, but Section 2.1's take-or-pay commitment is functionally a Customer-payable liquidated amount: USD 2,000,000 per year for three years remains due "without reduction or termination rights", i.e. regardless of Services actually taken and irrespective of termination (including our convenience termination right in Section 9.4 and force-majeure termination in Section 27.3). That exposure of up to USD 6,000,000 exceeds even the walk-away threshold of remaining contract value tied to non-performance, and it contradicts Section 7.1 (no minimum-use charge) and Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment). Our preferred position is no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer, so we delete the take-or-pay commitment; if a commitment is commercially essential, the fallback is an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer has no minimum-purchase, take-or-pay, or committed-spend obligation. Customer shall pay only for Services ordered under an Order Form and actually provided, and shall not owe any liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee, or minimum charge on termination, non-renewal, or reduced usage.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment: because it applies "without reduction or termination rights", it operates as a liquidated amount payable by us regardless of Services actually taken or of termination, which our playbook does not accept (and it conflicts with Sections 7.1, 9.4 and 12.3). If a commitment is commercially essential, we can accept an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.
proposal.summary: Delete the take-or-pay minimum commitment that operates as a liquidated amount payable by Customer.
